meta.name: NodesTracker
meta.shortDescription: Map live Dogecoin mainnet peers (full / pruned / light)
meta.longDescription: NodesTracker discovers Dogecoin mainnet peers from DNS seeds, completes P2P handshakes on port 22556, and shows who is live right now. The dashboard reports total/live/offline peers, live kind counts (full, pruned, light), and healthy full nodes on the agreed tip. Optional user/admin tokens gate peer APIs; hide_addresses can checksum public hostnames. Built from https://github.com/qlpqlp/nodestracker. DogeBOX seeds settings.json on first boot under /storage/nodestracker. Not a wallet.

sections.name: Web API

sections.name: Access and Security
sections.description: Optional tokens gate /api/peers and admin routes. Empty tokens leave those routes open. Values seed first-boot settings.json.
